question: Does reserve movement interact with the timing of food availability?
status: Exploratory; not adopted as main project findings.
movement: Translate remaining reserve only, +2 y cells before release; zero replenishment.
capture_phase: After all operations of the labeled completed update. Feeding/Paused names describe release at that update, not the next update. At update 0 release has not started.
planned_analysis: Compare occupancy (genome >= 0), spatial disagreement, within-phase occupancy changes, colonization and radiation gains, and movement x feeding differences at both feeding and complete-cycle ends. Single seed; no universal strategy ranking.

accounting.reserve_residual_bound: sum over release steps: 0.5 * float32 spacing(max initial capacity) * initial source cells; subtraction rounding only, no correction.
accounting.rationale: Float32 rate/addition/subtraction round; accumulate measured changes in float64. One ppm defines material end-of-experiment supply mismatch, not biological significance. Exact reserve replay must also pass. Record residuals without rescaling.

scope: Four specified conditions only. No schedule tuning, new physics, ASAL search, main-result edits, commits or pushes.
